title: Pin session_status + control_store_busy handling with a test: binding kept, uncertainty kept, exact keyless replay
outcome: Pin session_status + control_store_busy handling with a test: binding kept, uncertainty kept, exact keyless replay
acceptance: A test drives recovery/admission session_status to a remote control_store_busy reply and asserts: the routing token and active/uncertain grant are not cleared, no fresh bind happens, and the degraded admission schedules a retry that re-issues the same keyless session_status
A storage_error reply on the same path stays Unknown and is not treated as certified not-applied
